name: Track Time Saved
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Track Time Saved node to record how many minutes a workflow saves, based on the path an execution actually takes. n8n adds up every Track Time Saved node that runs during an execution and reports the total in Insights

parameters.name: Calculation Mode
parameters.description: Choose how n8n counts the minutes:

parameters.name: Minutes Saved
parameters.description: The number of minutes this step saves. Whole minutes, zero or more. Defaults to 0

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: For each run, time saved is the sum of all Time Saved nodes that execute. Use this when different execution paths or items save different amounts of time.

options.name: Once For All Items
options.description: Counts minutes saved once for all input items

options.name: Per Item
options.description: Multiply minutes saved by the number of input items

parameters.name: minutesSaved
parameters.description: Number of minutes saved by this workflow execution
